title: Document a filter with params and example
prompt: Write a docs/hooks.md entry for a filter: name, params table, and a short usage example.
referenceOutput:
### `wppo_inline_combined_css`

Return falsy to disable inlining of the combined CSS.

| Param | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `$inline` | `bool` | Whether to inline the combined stylesheet. |

```php
add_filter( 'wppo_inline_combined_css', '__return_false' );
```
